en-US: Build 192 internal device-testing candidate. Test the repaired flows. Office now reports the engine's real permission: a read-only or protected document stays in preview with a reason, an edit-password document prompts for the password, and an imported advanced chart workbook may refuse to save instead of silently rewriting it (the original file is preserved). The IDE routes each file type to its own surface (code, Office, PDF, CAD, image, media, Quick Look) and gives every open document a native tab; an Office tab shares one working copy between the embedded preview and full-screen editing. File preview adds Share for the visible document. Git adds staged/unstaged sections, per-file stage/unstage/discard with a .git/floe-recovery copy, a fast-forward that actually updates the working tree, and merge-conflict resolution. The IDE bottom panel embeds the local terminal and closing it keeps the shell alive; a busy engine returns exit 75 instead of a fake timeout; explicit npm and pnpm commands are never silently substituted. Disabling a model repairs the default to another usable model. Ordinary chat gains durable video tools with one optional reference image (PNG/JPEG/WebP up to 8 MiB); a replayed tool call reuses the same job and cancellation wins. GIF inspect/convert reads real frames and loop count. The signed catalog now offers Lua 5.4.8, Ruby 3.4.1 and PHP 8.2.33 (apt install floe/ruby or floe/php); interpreter startup may need a longer timeout or a background job. Limits: full UI acceptance was skipped by user request and only light validation was run; the build 191 iPad local-model crash is not proven fixed; an advanced workbook save may be rejected by design to protect your data; Apple processing and internal group visibility are verified separately from the upload. Physical-device acceptance is yours. Use your own cloud-model credentials. Include device, OS, model and the shortest reproduction in feedback.
zh-Hans: Build 192 内部真机测试候选版。请重点测试本轮修复。Office 现在按引擎真实权限工作：只读或受保护文档停留在预览并说明原因，需要编辑密码的文档会提示输入；导入的高级图表工作簿可能拒绝保存而不是静默改写（原文件会保留）。IDE 按文件类型进入各自的工作面（代码、Office、PDF、图纸、图片、媒体、快速查看），每个打开的文档都有原生标签；Office 标签的内嵌预览和全屏编辑共用同一个工作副本。文件预览新增“共享”，分享当前屏幕上的文档。Git 增加暂存／未暂存分区、逐文件暂存／取消暂存／放弃（在 .git/floe-recovery 保留恢复副本）、真正更新工作树的快进，以及合并冲突处理。IDE 底部嵌入本地终端，关闭面板不会结束 shell；引擎忙时返回 exit 75 而不是伪装超时；显式的 npm、pnpm 命令不会被静默替换。禁用某个模型后会自动修复默认模型。普通对话新增持久视频工具，可带一张参考图（PNG/JPEG/WebP，上限 8 MiB）；同一工具调用重放会复用已有任务，取消优先。GIF 检查与转换读取真实帧和循环次数。签名目录现在提供 Lua 5.4.8、Ruby 3.4.1 和 PHP 8.2.33（`apt install floe/ruby` 或 `floe/php`）；解释器启动可能超过 Shell 默认超时，请提高 timeout 或改用后台任务。限制：按你的要求跳过了完整界面验收，本轮只做轻量验证；Build191 报告的 iPad 本地模型崩溃尚未证实修复；高级工作簿保存可能按设计被拒绝以保护数据；Apple 处理与内部测试组可见性在签名上传后单独核验。真机验收由你完成。云端模型使用自己的凭据。反馈请带设备、系统、模型和最短复现步骤。
